decision.rule: GO requires a majority of the six evidence checks (at least four); STOP requires all four null-pattern checks; otherwise WEAK. This operationalizes the task's instruction to satisfy most GO criteria without tuning a model on test.
decision.next_stage_authorization: No reliability-gated intention model was started. Only GO would support considering it in a later explicitly authorized task.

protocol.scientific_question: Does zero-scene ensemble u_mean retain forecast-error ranking signal after controlling observed motion magnitude?
protocol.u_mean_definition: per future step, mean of the three models' 2D pixel distances from the ensemble mean; averaged across 15 future steps
protocol.motion_definition: pixel displacement between first and last observed target centers across 15 observation frames; observation only

high_error_thresholds.source: previous validation-only 80th percentile thresholds; reused unchanged
previous validation-only 80th percentile thresholds; reused unchanged

raw_motion_comparison.motion_only_ranking_direction: ascending observed_motion_magnitude; low motion is retained as lower risk

partial_correlation.method: rank-transform and linear residualization on ranked observed motion, then Pearson correlation

validation.method: rank-transform each variable; regress ranked U and ranked error separately on intercept + ranked observed motion; Pearson correlation of residuals

test.method: rank-transform each variable; regress ranked U and ranked error separately on intercept + ranked observed motion; Pearson correlation of residuals

validation.note: future_gt used only after score construction for post-hoc diagnosis

test.note: future_gt used only after score construction for post-hoc diagnosis

global.ranking_direction: ascending score; retain lowest values first
global.motion_only_direction: low observed motion is treated as lower risk and retained first
global.oracle_reference: ranks by true ADE; upper bound only, not deployable
global.coverage_sample_rule: floor(N*coverage), with all samples at 100% and at least one otherwise

motion_stratified.strata_definition: validation motion deciles, cutpoints frozen for test
motion_stratified.ranking_method: within each motion decile independently retain the lowest score fraction, then pool retained samples

within_motion_permutation.method: permute raw u_mean independently within each validation-defined motion decile; fixed motion, ADE, and FDE
within_motion_permutation.lower_tail_p_interpretation: small values mean observed stratified risk is lower than the within-motion random ranking

motion_stratified_metrics.decile_boundary_assignment: searchsorted on the nine interior validation quantiles; exact ties go to the higher decile

primary_video_cluster_bootstrap.method: resample the same number of clusters with replacement; include all samples for every draw, including repeated clusters

secondary_track_cluster_bootstrap.method: resample the same number of clusters with replacement; include all samples for every draw, including repeated clusters

validation.interpretation: Correlation is undefined when width/height are constant; report the observed resolution distribution rather than treating null as evidence of zero association.

test.interpretation: Correlation is undefined when width/height are constant; report the observed resolution distribution rather than treating null as evidence of zero association.

scale_diagnostics.normalized_u_definition: mean across 15 steps of the three normalized-coordinate predictions' mean 2D Euclidean distance from their normalized ensemble mean
